final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones and 30 delegations, with pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) as the recursive resolver. All PC startup scripts now point to pc32. The configuration includes the requested web, MX, and mail A records, using the existing machine addresses.

Static checks verified every delegation and glue address against the PC startup files, and all PC startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. Live DNS queries and BIND configuration checks could not be run: Kathara and BIND tools are unavailable in this environment, and access to Docker was denied. The lab image must provide `named`.

See [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-_u9medto/lab/DNS-README.md) for configuration details and commands to verify resolution after starting the lab.
